newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FAI says ahead of budget in 1st qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FAI says ahead of budget in 1st qtr.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd chief executive Rodney Adler said on Friday that the company was ahead of budget in its first quarter ending September 30.
"At our AGM to be held later this year our chairman will say that the first quarter was a good one," Adler told Reuters after a press briefing in Sydney.
Adler said the company remained confident of solid growth in the year to June 30, 1997.
In September, Adler said the company was looking at growth above two or three percent in 1996/97.
FAI's net result for the year to June 30 turned around to a profit of A$10.04 million from a loss of A$89.84 million in the previous year.
